answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a hardware-rooted attestation key, verified through remote attestation. A copied virtual machine cannot forge that evidence or reproduce the protected key; creating another valid identity therefore requires provisioning additional physical silicon. Even duplicated sable or onyx software remains insufficient, while the hardware anchor makes Sybil expansion costly and detectable.
